notes: §1985:IV.6.3.2.2 says the format "defines the order of their presentation in the source program", and §1985:IV.6.3.2.2.1 prints DATA DIVISION., then five optional sections in the order FILE, WORKING-STORAGE, LINKAGE, COMMUNICATION, REPORT: "file-description-entry {record-description-entry} ...", the sort-merge entry likewise, a report-file-description-entry with no record, 77-level and record entries in any order in WORKING-STORAGE and LINKAGE, "communication-description-entry [record-description-entry] ..." and "report-description-entry {report-group-description-entry} ...". The grammar rule dataDivision fixes the order and one occurrence of each section (the union rule also carries LOCAL-STORAGE and SCREEN); at 85 VersionConformancePass.VisitLocalStorageSection, VisitConstantEntryBody and VisitTypedefClause refuse the 2002 additions (COBOL0900), ScreenFacility.ReportSection declines the SCREEN SECTION (COBOL1560), and VisitCommunicationSection admits the COMMUNICATION SECTION. BindFileSection requires a record after an SD (COBOL1837) and refuses one after a report FD (COBOL2578), ScreenReportDescriptionHasGroup requires a report group after an RD (COBOL2708), and LevelNumberPass.VisitLevelNumber refuses level 77 under an FD or CD (COBOL1746). Probed right at --std 85: all five sections in order with every entry kind (h5.cob), five empty sections, 77 and 01 mixed in both orders; refused: every section out of order or written twice, a section with no DATA DIVISION header, LOCAL-STORAGE, SCREEN, 01 CONSTANT, TYPEDEF, an SD or RD with nothing after it, a record after a report FD, a 77 after an FD or a CD, a record with no CD or RD before it. PARTIAL because MaterializeImpliedRecord has no edition arm: an FD with a RECORD clause and no record description entry (the §2023:13.4.5.3 SR3 form) compiles and runs at 85, where the braces require one. The witness is a WORKING-STORAGE SECTION of 01, 77, 01.

next.reason: 1985 data division: FILE SECTION (file-description-entry {record-description-entry} …, sort-merge entries, report-file-description-entry), WORKING-STORAGE, LINKAGE, COMMUNICATION and REPORT sections. §2023:13.2.1 (with the section formats §2023:13.4.2, §2023:13.5.2, §2023:13.7.2 and §2023:13.8.2 restating it) has no COMMUNICATION SECTION, so a 1985 program with one is refused; it lets a file-description-entry have no record-description-entry ([ … ] …), adds constant-entry and type-declaration-entry, and adds LOCAL-STORAGE and SCREEN sections. Compile-time only.
